newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends little changed, thin.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends little changed, thin.

text.p: White sugar futures held recent firmer levels on Monday but in thin volume with many big players away.
Commission houses were the dominant force on the nearby months and were said to have been on both sides of the market, with scale-up sell orders in place just above current levels.
August last traded up 10 cents at $318.40 and October was up 20 cents at $308.00. Volume was just 461 lots.
The market found much-reduced liquidity due to public holidays across Europe and the absence of leading players in New York on account of this week's Sugar Dinner.
"It's New York Sugar Week so obviously a lot of the big boys are out there," said one trader.
